categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Cnano Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of nano-scale carbon materials and related products. Its main products include carbon nanotube powder, carbon nanotube conductive slurry, graphene composite conductive slurry, and carbon nanotube conductive masterbatch. These products are mainly applied in lithium-ion batteries, conductive plastics, and ultimately serve industries such as new energy vehicles, energy storage batteries, and 3C electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary technology for large-scale continuous production of carbon nanotubes using nano-agglomerate fluidized bed reactors, a breakthrough that solved the global challenge of continuous mass production. It employs chemical vapor deposition with advanced catalyst preparation techniques to control nanotube length, diameter, and purity. The company also pioneered the commercialization of carbon nanotube conductive slurry for lithium batteries, utilizing advanced dispersion technologies and equipment. It holds numerous domestic and international patents and leads in national and international standards for carbon nanotube conductive materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are leading domestic lithium battery manufacturers, with products widely used in power lithium batteries for new energy vehicles, energy storage batteries, and 3C digital electronics. The company has stable, long-term relationships with top-tier battery producers and international chemical companies for conductive plastics. Its products support the growing demand for high-performance lithium batteries driven by the expanding new energy vehicle and energy storage markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Jiangsu Province and subsidiaries in various Chinese cities including Changzhou and Meishan. It also has wholly-owned subsidiaries abroad in the United States and Germany, and a holding company in the British Virgin Islands. The overseas entities focus on intellectual property management and market development. The company actively expands its international market presence while maintaining a strong domestic footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Cnano Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of advanced carbon nanomaterials and conductive additives. It sources raw materials such as NMP, propylene, dispersants, and liquid nitrogen from upstream chemical suppliers and provides value-added products to downstream lithium battery manufacturers and conductive plastic producers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth with significant R&D investment, focusing on developing high-performance carbon nanotube products including single-wall nanotubes and composite conductive materials. It pursues continuous improvement in production processes, catalyst technology, and dispersion systems. Strategic R&D projects target applications in next-generation lithium batteries, solid-state batteries, conductive plastics, carbon-based chips, and wearable devices. The company also fosters strong collaborations with top universities and research institutes to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of carbon nanotube powders, conductive slurries, and masterbatches to lithium battery manufacturers and other industrial clients. The company uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors. It signs framework agreements with customers and fulfills orders based on product specifications, quantities, and delivery schedules. Additional income arises from licensing intellectual property and providing technical services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiangsu Cnano Technology is the leading domestic player in the carbon nanotube conductive slurry market, holding a 53.2% market share in China as of 2024. It has broken foreign monopolies in the lithium battery conductive additive sector and is recognized as an industry leader in production scale, customer base, and R&D capabilities. Major competitors include international chemical companies and emerging domestic nanomaterial producers, but the company’s advanced technology and scale provide a competitive moat.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.448 billion, a 3.13% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 250.2 million, a 15.8% decrease mainly due to non-recurring gains in the prior year. The company’s R&D expenditure increased by 15.27% to RMB 109.3 million, accounting for 7.55% of revenue. Total assets reached RMB 5.139 billion, with steady growth in net assets and operating cash flow. The company maintains a stable financial position with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance carbon nanotube conductive materials that significantly enhance lithium battery energy density, cycle life, and charging rates compared to traditional conductive agents. Its proprietary continuous production technology ensures stable quality and cost efficiency. The company’s products support advanced battery technologies including high-nickel cathodes and silicon-based anodes. It provides customized solutions and strong technical support, enabling customers to achieve superior battery performance and meet evolving market demands. The company’s leadership in patents, standards, and scale further differentiates it in the nanomaterials industry.
